verdict.rationale: Algolia's marketing overview lists 'AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search' as a feature, implying built-in vectorization without a custom pipeline, but there is no documentation describing embedder configuration, which models are used, or how document/query vectorization is managed under the hood. Missing for 10: detailed docs on embedder setup/configuration, explanation of managed embedding pipeline mechanics, and independent/hands-on confirmation that vectorization works without user-supplied embeddings.
